definitions.explanation: A stall set up in the evening along a street or in a shrine's grounds during a festival, selling snacks, toys and games such as {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい.

examples.japanese: {夜店|よみせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜店|よみせ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a candied apple at a night stall at the summer festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁日|えんにち}→縁日：10620_ennichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{夜店|よみせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だった。
examples.english: As a child, I looked forward to going round the night stalls at the shrine fair.

notes:
A compound of {夜|よ} (night) and ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (shop). Part of the atmosphere of Japanese summer festivals; the word has a nostalgic ring.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜店|よみせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: night stalls are set up
- {夜店|よみせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to stroll round the night stalls
- {夜店|よみせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい→金魚すくい：14661_kingyosukui⟧: goldfish scooping at a night stall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧: stall — any portable food stall, by day or by night
- ⟦{縁日|えんにち}→縁日：10620_ennichi⟧: shrine or temple fair — the occasion on which {夜店|よみせ} appear
